profile.name: Lateef Yomi Kareem
profile.headline: Senior Backend Engineer building distributed systems for fintech
summary: I'm a senior backend engineer with 6+ years of experience designing, building and operating distributed systems for fintech platforms. I build event-driven microservices in Java (Spring Boot), Go and TypeScript (NestJS) that process 10M+ daily transactions with sub-100ms latency and zero-downtime releases.

Having worked on teams without a dedicated DevOps engineer, I've owned the full delivery lifecycle: Linux servers, CI/CD pipelines, containers, Kubernetes clusters and infrastructure as code with Terraform on AWS, GCP and DigitalOcean.

A full-stack background with React, Next.js and React Native means I can carry a feature from the database to the interface. I own features end to end, from design and code review through deployment, and I care about correctness wherever money moves.

projects.title: Referral and reward platform
projects.summary: Event-driven Spring Boot platform that rewards customers instantly for card payments, transfers and VAS purchases, at 10M+ daily transactions with zero Kafka lag.
description: Moniepoint's referral and reward platform listens to payment and VAS events from Kafka and RabbitMQ across 50+ customer touchpoints, evaluates reward rules and publishes results to internal topics for downstream services.
Cashback is paid by posting journal transactions to the Core Banking Application. Every payout is idempotent, so retries and replays never pay a customer twice.

A shared reward queue lets 15+ internal teams publish reward events asynchronously, which cut their integration time by 60%. A gamification engine tracks customer tasks such as funding an account, paying bills and buying data, and pays cashback automatically.
MySQL and Google Cloud Spanner queries, backed by Redis caching, keep 10M+ daily eligibility checks under 100ms.

projects.title: MISPay Buy Now, Pay Later
projects.summary: Microservices for a BNPL platform in Riyadh, including a Go and Kafka CDC pipeline for near-real-time data sync, a Backoffice and a Merchant Panel.
description: MISPay provides a Buy Now, Pay Later service: customers buy goods and services immediately and pay in instalments over time.
I build and operate Go, NestJS and Java microservices on Kubernetes and GCP, communicating asynchronously over Kafka, with PostgreSQL, MongoDB and Redis for storage.
I built a high-performance change data capture pipeline in Go and Kafka. Goroutines process changes concurrently, which eliminated consumer lag and gave near-real-time data synchronisation.
I also engineered a Backoffice system that streamlines staff operations, a Merchant Panel for registered merchants, and internal packages that standardise service development.

projects.title: FiberOne SMS gateway
projects.summary: High-availability, multi-tenant SMS gateway processing millions of daily requests at 99.9% uptime for 5M+ customers and enterprises.
description: FiberOne is a Twilio-like platform for bulk SMS, OTP delivery and transactional messaging, with webhook support that reduced client integration time by 60%.
Message queuing and retry mechanisms absorb high-volume concurrent traffic without degrading the service, and intelligent routing across multiple telecom aggregators reduced delivery failures by 25%.

I designed the API authentication, rate limiting and billing for the multi-tenant platform, built admin dashboards for campaigns, analytics and billing, and improved API response times by 30% with query optimisation, Redis caching and asynchronous processing.

projects.title: AWS EKS with Terraform
projects.summary: A multi-AZ VPC and an autoscaling EKS cluster defined entirely in Terraform, running a containerised Express and MongoDB app.
description: Provisioned a VPC across multiple availability zones, with subnets, an internet gateway and route tables, plus an EKS cluster with an autoscaling managed node group, IAM roles and EKS access entries, all in Terraform.
Deployed a containerised Express and MongoDB application using Kubernetes Deployments, Services, ConfigMaps and Secrets.

projects.title: GKE and GCP networking with Terraform
projects.summary: A private-subnet VPC with Cloud Router, Cloud NAT and firewall rules for a GKE cluster, with Terraform state in a GCS bucket.
description: Built a custom VPC with private subnets, Cloud Router, Cloud NAT and firewall rules for a GKE cluster, with Terraform state stored remotely in a GCS bucket.
Provisioned Compute Engine VMs with service accounts and startup provisioning scripts.

projects.title: GitOps, Helm and Ingress on Kubernetes
projects.summary: A full-stack voting app delivered with ArgoCD, plus Spring Boot and Flask services packaged as Helm charts with autoscaling and Ingress routing.
description: Delivered a full-stack voting app with ArgoCD GitOps: a frontend, an API and a MongoDB StatefulSet with persistent volumes.

Packaged Spring Boot and Python Flask services as Helm charts with horizontal pod autoscaling and Ingress, managed releases with Helmfile, and set up path- and host-based Ingress routing for microservices.

projects.title: Linux automation and security scripting
projects.summary: Bash tooling: a cross-distro update script, a scanner for compromised npm packages, and a Traefik reverse proxy with Docker service discovery.
description: Wrote a cross-distro (Debian, Ubuntu, Arch, Fedora) system update script with logging and error handling.
Built a multi-project scanner that detects compromised npm package versions after a supply-chain attack.
Set up a Traefik reverse proxy with Docker service discovery for multi-container workloads.

projects.title: Cloudenly

I worked on its backend: microservices built with Node.js, Express and GraphQL, using PostgreSQL, MySQL and MongoDB, Redis, and RabbitMQ for messaging between services.
